source: Authored at Step 13 from plan section 9: the five outcome kinds, each returned in its own form (group P8-T4).

kinds.name: completed gate run
kinds.form: one ComputedResult and its printed forms, or defect reports under kind 4

kinds.name: open case run
kinds.form: a result record carrying the OPEN CASE state and no rollup word

kinds.name: precheck run under the listed not run condition
kinds.form: a result record with no rollup word and the precheck words at contract field 12, with its label and consequence line

kinds.name: form agreement disagreement
kinds.form: DefectReports and no form, a completed run with a tool defect

kinds.name: cannot start run
kinds.form: a CannotStartOutcome and no result record
